title: Business Compiler Runtime v1.0 Apple-ready handover
objective: Turn the canvas/runtime concept into a committed deployable app with Supabase schema, compiler API, queue/evidence writers, service catalogue, launch gates, Vercel deployment path, and receipt trail.

survivability_definition.name: 72h successful continuity, not unattended failure
survivability_definition.rule: 72h survivability means the runtime operates successfully for 72 continuous hours with active health checks, telemetry continuity, automatic recovery, replay validation, and escalation on failure. A broken system left untouched for 72h is a failed survivability test, not a pass.
pass_conditions: health checks remain green or recover within policy threshold
telemetry ledger has no unexplained gaps beyond accepted heartbeat interval
failed jobs are retried and either recovered or escalated with evidence
evidence writer continues creating receipts for runtime actions
recovery replay is tested and produces deterministic result
no critical launch gate silently changes state without evidence
operator brief shows continuity, incidents, recovery actions and unresolved blockers
fail_conditions: manual discovery of failure after test window
critical error not surfaced to operator brief
survivability_definition.required_receipt: survivability_receipt must include start_time, end_time, heartbeat_count, incident_count, recovered_incident_count, unresolved_incidents, telemetry_gap_report, replay_result, recovery_result, final_classification

deliverables_required: Commit runnable React/Next/Vite app surface from canvas into repo or command-centre route
Add Supabase migrations for canonical runtime schema
Implement compiler API: idea -> business_instance, business_stack, launch_gate, runtime_queue, evidence_requirements, economic_runtime, country_pack
Implement service catalogue registry with executable input/output contracts
Implement queue writer for compile/gate/evidence/runtime jobs
Implement evidence writer that records receipts and classifies REAL/PARTIAL/MISSING
Implement launch gate evaluator that blocks production without critical evidence
Seed Outcome Ready / Family AI launch instance
Add Vercel deployment configuration and build verification
Add acceptance harness: schema validation, compiler smoke test, queue insert, evidence insert, gate evaluation, app build, deployment health check
Add 72h successful continuity harness with heartbeat, telemetry gap detection, automatic retry/recovery, replay validation and escalation
Write audit log row with commit, deployment URL, test results, evidence classification
canonical_schema_sql_addendum: alter table if exists business_runtime.survivability_receipt add column if not exists start_time timestamptz; alter table if exists business_runtime.survivability_receipt add column if not exists end_time timestamptz; alter table if exists business_runtime.survivability_receipt add column if not exists heartbeat_count int default 0; alter table if exists business_runtime.survivability_receipt add column if not exists incident_count int default 0; alter table if exists business_runtime.survivability_receipt add column if not exists recovered_incident_count int default 0; alter table if exists business_runtime.survivability_receipt add column if not exists unresolved_incidents jsonb default '[]'; alter table if exists business_runtime.survivability_receipt add column if not exists telemetry_gap_report jsonb default '{}'; alter table if exists business_runtime.survivability_receipt add column if not exists replay_result text; alter table if exists business_runtime.survivability_receipt add column if not exists final_classification text check (final_classification in ('REAL','PARTIAL','MISSING','REJECTED'));

72h_successful_continuity_test: retry failed runtime jobs automatically within policy
escalate unrecovered jobs before the next operator brief
write survivability receipt only if continuous operation is proven
mark REJECTED if runtime is merely broken and untouched

requested_runtime_action: Bridge runner should amend the prior v1.0 handover with this survivability definition. 72h is a successful-continuity proof, not a waiting period. If the runtime breaks and remains broken, classify survivability as REJECTED/MISSING and escalate immediately.
